routes.candidate_material: 1999 Simon & Schuster Star Trek: Deep Space Nine Companion PC CD-ROM
routes.observed_claim: Transcribed box-back description says its searchable library contains shooting scripts for all episodes; reseller lists the edition as a Simon & Schuster 1999 PC CD-ROM
routes.next_gate: Locate authorized physical disc or bit-preserved image, hash medium and per-episode extract privately, verify packaging/publisher identity and script draft/revision labels

routes.candidate_material: Writers Guild Foundation original script copies and archival material
routes.observed_claim: Institution reports a few DS9 scripts in its library and permits in-person research; its FAQ explicitly excludes remote script copies and loans
routes.next_gate: Obtain item-level catalog identity and permitted supervised consultation; document draft title/date/version without copying protected text

routes.candidate_material: UC Riverside MS 379 Film and television scripts collection
routes.observed_claim: The archive reports preliminary, first, and final DS9/Voyager script drafts, donated in 2011, with research access and reproduction/rights restrictions
routes.next_gate: Resolve exact DS9 box/folder/draft identifiers and permissible access at UCR before comparing against any episode cut or other draft

routes.candidate_material: Public Star Trek Minutiae collected DS9 script index
routes.observed_claim: Public index links DS9 episode scripts and an all-series ZIP; original production-copy custody and edition fidelity not established by this inventory
routes.next_gate: Obtain allowed item-level source lineage and compare only after Director hold lifts; do not treat mirror and CD content as independent witnesses

routes.observed_claim: Publisher's episode catalog provides cards and metadata but is not itself a viewed audiovisual performance
routes.next_gate: Within authorized access and after queue resume, log edition/region/cut/runtime and timecode evidence without reproducing audiovisual bytes publicly
